context: Tests a tag-only semantic-release plus GoReleaser pipeline with draft-first immutable publication, attestation, and a native GitHub App-signed Homebrew cask update.

checklist.name: Tag-only semantic-release
checklist.description: Plugins include commit-analyzer, release-notes-generator, and github, but no npm or source-writeback plugin.

checklist.name: Draft-first release
checklist.description: @semantic-release/github creates a draft and GoReleaser is configured to reuse that draft without publishing early.

checklist.name: Exact release-state gate
checklist.description: The workflow resolves the exact tag at HEAD and checks that release's draft/published state before running GoReleaser, allowing safe retries.

checklist.name: GoReleaser clean build
checklist.description: GoReleaser runs release --clean from a full-SHA-pinned goreleaser-action.

checklist.name: Tap naming
checklist.description: The cross-repository tap uses a homebrew- prefixed repository name.

checklist.name: Scoped App token
checklist.description: A short-lived GitHub App token is scoped explicitly to the source and tap repositories; no broad PAT is introduced.

checklist.name: Attestation permissions
checklist.description: The release job grants id-token: write and attestations: write.

checklist.name: Attest before publish
checklist.description: Release assets are attested while the release is draft, before explicit publication.

checklist.name: Current cask publisher
checklist.description: .goreleaser.yaml uses homebrew_casks rather than deprecated brews and targets the tap repository.

checklist.name: Native signed tap commit
checklist.description: The cask sets commit_author.use_github_app_token: true and does not set custom author/committer identity fields.

checklist.name: No extra tap commit job
checklist.description: GoReleaser owns the cask update; there is no second OS job, formula renderer, local git push, or generic commit action.

checklist.name: Full history
checklist.description: Verify and release checkouts use fetch-depth: 0.

checklist.name: Release concurrency
checklist.description: Release has a job-level non-cancellable concurrency group.

checklist.name: Step-scoped tokens
checklist.description: The App token is passed to GoReleaser as GITHUB_TOKEN and HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN at step scope.

checklist.name: Publish and prove
checklist.description: The workflow explicitly publishes the draft, runs gh release verify, and reads back the tap commit signature after the release.
